_metadata.source: Qualitative market research quantified into 0-10 scores

scoring_methodology.demand_level: Tenant demand strength: vacancy rates, population growth, employment anchors. 10 = extreme demand, 0 = no demand.
scoring_methodology.supply_tightness: How constrained is rental supply. LOW available supply = HIGH score. 10 = virtually no supply, 0 = oversupplied.
scoring_methodology.tenant_quality: Reliability of tenant pool. Professionals, healthcare workers, retirees score high; students and informal tenants score lower. 10 = premium tenants only, 0 = high-risk pool.
scoring_methodology.catalyst_proximity: Proximity to major demand catalysts: Life Paarl Valley Hospital (H2 2027, 140-250 beds), Paarl Mall R270M redevelopment (Nov 2026), CPUT Wellington campus, Winelands Square, Val de Vie expansion, Boland College. 10 = adjacent to multiple catalysts, 0 = no catalysts nearby.
scoring_methodology.infrastructure_quality: Fibre coverage, road access, rail connectivity, water and energy reliability. 10 = full fibre + excellent roads + rail + reliable utilities, 0 = no infrastructure.

_metadata.notes: Scores reflect relative positioning within the Boland region (Paarl, Wellington, Malmesbury). A score of 10 is exceptional by local standards, not national benchmarks.

1_bed.note: Very small sample — treat with caution

Lemoenkloof.notes: Most sought-after family suburb. Premium tenants. Near Optenhorst Village retail. Full fibre coverage.

Courtrai.notes: Popular family suburb near top schools. Premium tenant pool.

Paarl Central.notes: Older sectional title stock. Walking distance to amenities. SDF supports densification.

Paarl South.notes: Near Boland College. Student and young professional demand. New developments underway.

Northern Paarl.notes: New development corridor in SDF (Dal Josafat). Limited existing stock.

Groenheuwel.notes: Good schools, young families. Mountain Ridge Estate development.

Denneburg.notes: Quiet residential. Retirees and professionals dominate tenant pool.

Paarl East.notes: Near Boland College Drakenstein campus. Student and young professional demand.

New Orleans.notes: Mixed quality — newer/renovated units only viable. Affordable entry point.

Esterville.notes: Residential, reasonable tenant pool. Near Paarl Central amenities.

Paarl North.notes: Growing area. Near Life Paarl Valley Hospital site — major catalyst for healthcare worker demand.

La Vie Estate.notes: Secure estate with good tenant pool.

Southern Paarl.notes: Near N1 access and retirement facilities.

Wellington Central.notes: Near CPUT campus (2,200 students). Strong student demand but limited quality stock.

Malmesbury Central.notes: Young first-time buyers and renters. Growing demand.

Dalsig.notes: Established area with Zwartland Hof complex.
